Tavidyut “%1$s” %2$s; abeddel n wakaram kan (aremuks) ur yezmir ara ad yebeddel akudik, ihi ur yezmir ara ad yettwasnulfu Live Photo.\n\nBeddel deg «Iɣewwaren → Atranskud n tividyutin → Amezruy n utranskud» ɣer «Rekudi», neɣ sefli-t zdat ɣer MP4 H.264/H.265 s wayeḍ n umahi.

Tavidyut mačči deg wakaram MP4 amezduɣ (MOV / MKV / WebM / AVI atg.), syen «Amezruy n utranskud» n tura ur yekkis ara akudik, ihi ur yezmir ara ad yettwasnulfu Live Photo.\n\nBeddel deg «Iɣewwaren → Atranskud n tividyutin → Amezruy n utranskud» ɣer «Rekudi» (lqem amezduɣ yesεa akudik ffmpeg; lqem Go afessus ur yesεi ara atranskudar, seqdec lqem amezduɣ), neɣ sefli tavidyut zdat ɣer MP4 amezduɣ (H.264/H.265).

Tavidyut tezger 3 tesdiyin

Tavidyut yettwafren tezger 3 tesdiyin, ihi Live Photo yettwasnulfen yezmer ad yesεu uguren n umṣada:

• Yezmer ur yetturar ara akken ilaq
• Yezmer ur yettwasnen ara s tgalri n unagraw
• Kra n yilugan zemren ur snen ara Live Photo-a
Yettwaf lqem aqdim
Mazal yers lqem aqdim (lqem Go) n usnas-a deg yalugan-a. Lqem aqdim-nni ur yezmir ara ad yettwasqdec deg yalugan-a; tzemreḍ ad t-tkekseḍ i ufran n wammud.
Amezruy n ubeddel yesεa tilufa n lexṣara

Amezruy n ubeddel ad yaru agmuḍ n usefli srid ɣer ifula n tɣawsa; mbaɛd ubeddel ifula n tɣawsa ur zmiren ara ad ttwafrun.

• Ma yettwaḥbes usnas, neɣ tettwacceṛ tkatut, neɣ tettwakkes tsiregt deg tira, ifula n tɣawsa zemren ad xesren
• Ulac asefli yettwaḍamnen ad yeddu, syen deg usenqed ifula n tɣawsa zemren ad ilin ur zmiren ara ad ttwaseqdecen
• Ɛreḍ s yiwen neɣ sin ifula zdat, i ussenqed, send asluɣu s ugeraw
• Ḥrez tiwlafin tixatarin s ufus zdat

Tamahilt-a tettwaf am «akken tella»; tesqedceḍ-itt s tilufa-ik, syen ameskar ur yesεi ara tamast i yifula yexsen neɣ yettwaṣṣfen.
